title: 八机构在场：农村却无援助，疫情如何控制？
speaker: Declan Walsh

segments.en: We were there for several days we've spoken with the medical staff got their permission we got the permission from the patients to enter that ward and you know we I just felt it was very important to witness firsthand and to show the reality of care in the Congo it particularly in this front line area here in the main city Boone the head of the WHO has been here the last couple of days Dr. Tedros Gaby Jesus.
segments.zh: 我们在那里待了几天，与医务人员沟通并获得许可，也得到患者同意进入病房。我觉得亲眼目睹并展示刚果的医疗现实非常重要，尤其是在这个前线地区。世卫组织总干事谭德塞博士过去几天也在主要城市布滕博。

segments.en: There are you know eight agencies are present here there's certainly some supplies coming in I was at the opening of a new isolation ward in the city this morning.
segments.zh: 这里有八个机构，确实有一些物资运抵。我今天早上参加了城里一个新隔离病房的启用仪式。

segments.en: But up there in those rural areas where the greatest number of cases are found for a whole combination of factors it's extremely difficult very little aid has reached there so far and you know they're in a crisis situation which of course is bad terrible news for the people who are already sick.
segments.zh: 但在那些病例最多的农村地区，由于多种因素，援助极少到达，他们处于危机状态，这对已经生病的人来说是坏消息。

segments.en: But it also means that the spread of this virus is frankly unknown and probably still uncontained.
segments.zh: 这也意味着病毒的传播情况未知，很可能仍未得到控制。

segments.en: Someone we've spoken about with Jeremy Connondike public health official from from the US with Tom Frieden former head of the CDC as well as just about the cultural difficulties here conveying to the population the seriousness of this outbreak and you point to something very worrisome in your piece you say many refuse to accept the virus was real you continue some said the outbreak was a money making plot concocted by Congolese doctors.
segments.zh: 我们与美国公共卫生官员杰里米·科农迪克、前CDC主任汤姆·弗里登等人讨论过这里的文化困难：向民众传达疫情的严重性。你在报道中指出令人担忧的一点：许多人拒绝相信病毒真实存在，有些人说疫情是刚果医生编造的赚钱阴谋。

segments.en: And forward aid workers others call it a curse as we talk about the deficit in the public health response to this crisis.
segments.zh: 还有人称其为诅咒，我们讨论的是公共卫生应对的不足。

segments.en: How acute is this problem in particular just conveying to the population how dangerous this is and trying to explain in light of those... The sense the sense of what's happening here that that in fact is not the case this is a very serious virus.
segments.zh: 向民众传达危险性的问题有多严重？实际上，这是一种非常严重的病毒。
